Evaluations must require descriptor-exact or at least method-exact names for overload-dense classes.

'Sole/only consumer' claims are falsified or unverified at reference level: ktlint answers (0778dbd56e60, dac24228ae3f, def06d674b6b) call findRuleSuppressionIds the sole consumer of SUPPRESS_ANNOTATION_RULE_MAP while the oracle shows a synthetic accessor and Companion getter also referencing the field. Unsupported predictive certainty: emphatic breakage predictions ('WILL BREAK', 'will fail', 'expected to break') on BaselineResultMappingSpec tests (42e798a8d084, 866466f3f04e, aa59036509f8, f805a7b01155) and failure-mode assertions (NPE vs JSONException) in fastjson2 answers are outside the frozen oracle or conceded-inferred in the same answer's unknowns. A future evaluation must separate evidence-backed mechanism claims from outcome predictions.

Recall spread is extreme even within cases: detekt answers range 0→4 oracle matches and jackson answers 0→3 of 32, with several answers (1d4d39df1210, 89d07d94972e, f632019f2bcf, d03628ddd394) at or near zero despite cap headroom. One null answer (84fe91ffabef) requires an explicit failed-response convention distinct from zero recall.

Best-scoring pattern visible in-packet: declaration-level naming of oracle identities (descriptors or exact test ids) plus avoidance of self-caller entries (42e798a8d084 achieves 4/4 on detekt; 3edee05b109d uniquely captures the TokenStreamFactory override targets).
limitations: This audit used only the packet. Quoted line numbers, test bodies, and file contents in the answers were not verified against any source tree; no source files absent from the packet were checked.

The oracle is explicitly incomplete ('known review anchors only, not complete behavioral impact'). All targets outside it — including the BaselineResultMappingSpec and PlaceholderSymbolTableTest items several answers emphasize — are recorded as unadjudicated, never as false positives.

fasterxml__jackson-core-1016 has a recall ceiling of 0.375 (32 oracle entries vs response cap 12); per-answer recall figures for that case are ceiling-limited and must not be compared naively with the other three cases (ceiling 1.0).

Condition names and the correspondence key are withheld; condition-specific effects could not be assessed, and answer prose mentioning graph/javap-style evidence was treated as untrusted data, not as a blinding signal.

Overlap counts use declaration-level identity (name + arity/parameter types or exact test id); answers matching only at file/line level were conservatively scored as non-matching rather than partially matching.
This is a measurement-quality audit only: no rescoring, no oracle edits, no runtime verification of any claim, and no ranking of hidden cohorts.
